✨ CraftHub | C#
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a user-friendly interface for managing programming language class definitions and facilitating the creation, export, and comparison of JSON data structures.
✨ Key Features: • Class Upload and Creation • Custom Class Management • JSON Generation and Export • JSON Comparison (document changes and multi-file comparison) • Configurable difference detection (key order, array order, case, nulls, specific paths)
📖 Summary: CraftHub is a C# application built with Avalonia for .NET, offering robust tools for managing programming language classes and generating/comparing JSON data. It allows users to upload or create classes, save them, and then use these structures to easily generate and export JSON, with advanced features for comparing multiple JSON files.
